name: Scaphoid Fracture
summary: The scaphoid is the most commonly fractured carpal bone, usually in young adults after a fall on the outstretched hand. Its blood supply enters from the distal end, so fractures of the waist or proximal pole risk non-union and avascular necrosis (bone death) if missed.

looksLike: Radial wrist pain after a fall, sometimes mild, so the patient may think it is a sprain.
Ask about the mechanism (fall on an extended wrist), timing, and whether X-rays were taken.
redFlags: Fall plus snuffbox or tubercle tenderness, even with a normal X-ray
firstSteps: Immobilisation can be long (often 6 to 12 weeks or more depending on site). During immobilisation, keep the fingers, elbow and shoulder moving.

differentials: Fall plus snuffbox or tubercle tenderness, even with a normal X-ray
measures: Range, grip, pain on weight bearing (push-up position), PRWE.

blocks.text: The scaphoid is the most commonly fractured carpal bone, usually in young adults after a fall on the outstretched hand. Its blood supply enters from the distal end, so fractures of the waist or proximal pole risk non-union and avascular necrosis (bone death) if missed [Ref – to verify]. Early X-rays can be normal.

sections.title: B to C. Presentation and questions

items: Radial wrist pain after a fall, sometimes mild, so the patient may think it is a sprain.
Ask about the mechanism (fall on an extended wrist), timing, and whether X-rays were taken.

sections.title: D to E. Examination and tests

rows: Press in the hollow between the thumb extensor tendons with the thumb extended
Press on the palmar side at the base of the thenar eminence with wrist extended
Push the thumb along its long axis toward the wrist

blocks.text: These signs are sensitive but not specific; together they increase suspicion [Ref – to verify].

sections.title: F to G. Differential and red flags

rows: Fall plus snuffbox or tubercle tenderness, even with a normal X-ray
Immobilise in a splint; refer for repeat imaging or MRI as per local pathway

steps: **Fall on the hand with radial wrist pain?** Test snuffbox, tubercle and axial compression.
**Any positive?** Treat as a fracture until proven otherwise: splint and refer for imaging.
**Confirmed fracture:** cast or surgical fixation per surgeon; physiotherapy after immobilisation.

sections.title: I to L. Rehabilitation after union

blocks.text: Immobilisation can be long (often 6 to 12 weeks or more depending on site) [Ref – to verify]. During immobilisation, keep the fingers, elbow and shoulder moving. After union: active wrist range, carpal mobilisation, grip and weight-bearing progression, sport-specific loading (push-ups, falls training). Return to contact sport only with surgeon approval.
Range, grip, pain on weight bearing (push-up position), PRWE.

items: **Why can a normal X-ray mislead?** Scaphoid fractures may not be visible initially.
**Why are proximal fractures risky?** The blood supply enters distally, so the proximal fragment may lose its supply.
**Name three clinical tests.** Snuffbox tenderness, scaphoid tubercle tenderness, thumb axial compression.
**What do you do if tests are positive but X-ray is normal?** Splint and refer for further imaging.
**What is the main long-term complication?** Non-union and avascular necrosis, leading to arthritis.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Recognise a possible scaphoid fracture after a fall.
Act correctly when X-rays are normal.

sections.A: Scaphoid kalai ki sab se zyada tootne wali haddi hai, aksar naujawanon mein haath ke bal girne se. Is ka khoon ka supply kamzor hai, is liye theek se na jure to masle hote hain.
sections.B: Girne ke baad kalai ke angoothe wali taraf dard, kabhi halka, is liye log isay moch samajhte hain. Chot ka tareeqa zaroor poochein.
sections.D: Anatomical snuffbox, scaphoid tubercle aur angoothe par axial compression. Koi bhi positive ho to shak karein.
sections.F: Girne ke baad snuffbox par dard, X-ray normal ho tab bhi: splint aur dobara imaging ke liye refer. Mahinon baad kalai dard: non-union ka shak.
sections.H: Haath ke bal gire aur kalai mein dard ho to tests karein. Koi positive ho to fracture samajh kar splint aur refer.
sections.I: Plaster lamba (6 se 12 hafte ya zyada) ho sakta hai. Us dauraan ungliyan, kohni aur kandha chalte rahein. Haddi judne ke baad range, grip aur weight bearing.
sections.M: Range, grip, push-up position mein dard aur PRWE dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Yaad rakhein: shuru mein X-ray par scaphoid fracture nazar nahi aata.
